records.title: Time, Velocity, and Speed — elapsed time
records.adopted: Elapsed time is ending clock reading minus starting reading; stopped stopwatch can directly show duration.
records.rejected: College-level velocity formalism not imposed; distance and time identification first.
records.usageRestrictions: Conceptual corroboration only, no textbook text/images copied; book-specific current licence not presumed.
records.limitations: Physics truth source, not empirical evidence of Finnish pupil understanding.

records.title: Position, displacement and average velocity
records.adopted: Keep position/displacement distinct from elapsed interval and travelled path.
records.rejected: Do not equate final coordinate to travelled distance; no vector calculus required.
records.usageRestrictions: Independent original text/figures; no reproduced protected material.
records.limitations: Own four bounded kinematic scenarios, not real measured tracks or efficacy proof.

records.title: NIST SI guide — time units
records.adopted: s denotes second; length and time have distinct unit dimensions.
records.rejected: Unit symbols are not interchangeable just because numerical values coincide.
records.usageRestrictions: Definitions corroborated; no source table/prose copied.
records.limitations: Unit fact only; pedagogical design and model parameters project-authored.

planning.teacherObjective: Matkan ja ajan tunnistaminen liikkeen mitattaviksi suureiksi
planning.childGoal: Erotan kuljetun matkan ja siihen kuluneen ajan.
planning.assumptions: Frozen required QTY01 and MOTIONREF; introduce path vs coordinate and model subtraction explicitly. No added hard graph gate.
planning.scope: Length/path and elapsed time in selected measured motion interval; not complete kinematics, speed formula, uncertainty or physical measuring competence.
planning.evidenceLimits: Report interpretation, units and simple derivation are low-stakes; optional support/model/feedback available, no independence/retention/personal evidence claim.
planning.sourceVsDesign: Frozen graph provenance inherited; no new OPH requirement or efficacy claim. Story, examples, exact model bounds, controls and pedagogical sequencing are project design.
planning.assetProvenance: Original deterministic SVG. User-supplied actual transparent Aava/Loikka PNG unchanged, named in lesson, no substitute character artwork or decorative motion.

extensions.executionLimits: 4 declared trajectories;0.1modelsecond integer ticks, up to movementend+2second observation;100ms playback approximate1x, step1modelsecond. Stop own measure at chosen event end; no internal waiting segments. Pause/reset/dispose clear interval; no autoplay. Active instance owned per resolved lesson root; previous mount disposed. Current visible enum controls validated, input/change handled and check re-reads current premise; blank/unsupported does not silently become zero. New mount actively enables its own controls after previous instance disposal; synthetic and native regression retains original disabled-remount failure. Plain decimal digit bounds apply after harmless leading/trailing-zero normalization (raw input max128characters); only plain decimal numeric response text is supported, not fraction-input notation. No rounding or scientific/expression eval. Static initial.svg derives from the same exact initial model state as mount; solved originalSVG retained separately in explanation. No-JavaScript fallback and live initial readout stay compatible.
